quienes_descripcion: Sabor is a web platform created to revolutionize gastronomic management and experience, facilitating interaction between customers and restaurants through innovative digital solutions.
quienes_mision: To provide our customers with a unique culinary experience, based on fresh ingredients, personalized attention, and a welcoming atmosphere.
quienes_vision: To be recognized as the leading web platform in innovation and quality for restaurant management, always exceeding our users' expectations and facilitating the digital experience in the gastronomic sector.
sobre_subtitulo: Discover our passion for Colombian gastronomy
sobre_historia: Founded in 2023, Sabor was born from the dream of sharing a passion for good food and exceptional service. Since then, we have put our hands to work to make this project a reality.
sobre_equipo: We have highly trained chefs, waiters, and administrative staff dedicated to providing the best service.
sobre_contacto: Do you have questions or suggestions? Write to us at sabor.software@sabor.com or call us at +57 3044541620.
